# Pixel Engineers

> Elite Custom Software Development, High-Performance Website Development, Custom CRM & ERP Engineering, and Digital Growth Agency.

Pixel Engineers is a full-service software engineering and digital transformation company. We partner with ambitious startups, scale-ups, and established enterprises to design, build, and deploy mission-critical software, custom CRM solutions, high-converting websites, and SaaS platforms.

## Core Capabilities & Services

### 1. Custom Software Development
- Enterprise-grade web platforms and business automation software
- Multi-tenant SaaS architecture, cloud infrastructure, and microservices
- Custom API design, third-party integrations, and legacy modernization
- Database architecture (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis) and real-time data streaming
- High-security compliance (SOC2, HIPAA, GDPR readiness)

### 2. Website Development & Web Engineering
- Modern, ultra-fast websites built with Next.js, React, and TypeScript
- Headless CMS architecture (Sanity, Strapi, Contentful) and Shopify Plus headless commerce
- Server-side rendering (SSR), static site generation (SSG), and edge computing
- Core Web Vitals optimization, accessibility (WCAG AA), and high conversion design
- Interactive 3D web experiences, WebGL, and Three.js creative engineering

### 3. Custom CRM & ERP Development
- Bespoke CRM systems built around specific sales, support, and operational workflows
- Pipeline management, automated lead routing, and customer lifecycle tracking
- Custom ERP modules: inventory management, invoicing, analytics, and HR tools
- Bi-directional sync with HubSpot, Salesforce, Stripe, Zoho, and enterprise databases
- Role-based access control (RBAC), audit trails, and automated email/SMS sequences

### 4. Digital Marketing, SEO & Generative Engine Optimization (GEO / AEO)
- Search Engine Optimization (Technical SEO, on-page optimization, content architecture)
- Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) for ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini
- Performance marketing, lead generation funnels, and conversion rate optimization (CRO)
- Analytics setup (GA4, Mixpanel, Segment) and data tracking dashboards

### 5. UI/UX Design & Brand Systems
- User research, wireframing, high-fidelity prototypes (Figma), and user testing
- Scalable design systems, component libraries, and brand visual identities
- Conversion-centered UI designed to turn visitors into qualified inquiries

## Technology Stack
- **Frontend:** Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Three.js, GSAP, Framer Motion
- **Backend:** Node.js, Python, Go, Express, FastAPI, GraphQL, REST
- **Database:** PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, Supabase
- **Cloud & DevOps:** AWS, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Vercel, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD
- **AI & Integrations:** OpenAI API, Anthropic API, Stripe, Twilio, SendGrid, Zapier

## Target Clients
- B2B companies looking for custom CRM or ERP tools to replace fragmented SaaS subscriptions
- High-growth startups needing full-stack MVP or scalable SaaS development
- Brands seeking enterprise-grade websites with 95+ Google PageSpeed performance
- Enterprises requiring secure custom software with seamless system integration
